title: Run env manifest — references, not values
description: Shape only. The rule that every value is a vault:// reference, the resolution against the process environment, and the eight refusals are enforced by scripts/check_secret_ref_spec.py and specified in docs/core/secret-refs.md (contract secret-ref@1).

contract.description: The parity with which this manifest was written.

runId.description: The run this environment belongs to. It becomes a file name, so it is checked like one.

env.description: Name to reference. A value here is the one thing this contract forbids (E-SEC-01).

^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$.description: vault://<file>#<key> — a path inside the vault repository and a dot path inside the document.

required.description: The names the run's tools cannot start without (E-SEC-06 when one is not declared).
